description: This file contains Sass mixins for styling button variants and sizes, used in a CSS framework or theme, specifically for styling Bootstrap buttons.

methods.name: button-variant
methods.description: A Sass mixin to generate button styles with customizable color, background, and border, including various states such as hover, focus, active, and disabled.

methods.name: button-size
methods.description: A Sass mixin to define button size properties like padding, font size, line height, and border radius.
